title: Mixed Torsion on Right Triangles and the Pólya--Szegő Monotonicity Problem for Regular Polygons
summary: Motivated by the polygonal Pólya--Szegő conjecture for torsional rigidity, we study two monotonicity problems for torsional rigidity. The first concerns a mixed torsion problem on fixed-area right triangles, with a Dirichlet condition on one leg and Neumann conditions on the other leg and on the hypotenuse. We prove that the mixed torsional rigidity strictly increases as the ratio of the Neumann leg to the Dirichlet leg increases.
